column5: rules
Choose 1 of your Agent assigned to Waterdeep Harbor.  Return it to your pool, then immediately assign 2 Agents
Each opponent removes 1 oj from his or her Tavern and returns it to the supply.  For each opponent that could not do so, take 1 oj from the supply and place it in your Tavern.
Each opponent removes 1 pu from his or her Tavern and returns it to the supply.  For each opponent that could not do so, draw 1 Intrigue
Each opponent removes 1 bl from his or her Tavern and returns it to the supply.  For each opponent that could not do so, take 2 gold from the supply and place it in your Tavern.

Draw a Quest from the deck equal to the number of players.  Keep one and pass the remaining Quests to the player on your left.  Each player, in turn, chooses 1 Quest to keep, and passes the rest to the left until every player has taken a Quest.
pay 2 gold.  Choose an aciton space containing an opponent's Agent.  You use that space's action as though you had assigned an Agent to it.
take 2 any from the supply and place them in your Tavern.  Each opponent takes 1 any from the supply and places it in his or her tavern
Choose 1 of the following to take from the supply: 4 gold, 2 oj, 2 bl, 1 pu, 1 wh
discard an uncompleted Quest.  Score 6 VP.  Each opponent can choose to discard un uncompleted Quest to score 3 VP (You can discard a Mandatory Quest in this way)
Take 2 oj from the supply and place it in your Tavern.  Choose 1 opponent.  That opponent takes 1 oj from the supply and places it in his or her Tavern
Take 2 bl from the supply and place it in your Tavern.  Choose 1 opponent.  That opponent takes 1 bl from the supply and places it in his or her Tavern
2 oj + 1 pu = 2 VP
1 oj + 1 bl + 1 pu = 2 VP
Remove any from an opponent's Tavern and the place it in your Tavern
Take 2 wh from the supply and place it in your Tavern.  Choose 1 opponent.  That opponent takes 1 wh from the supply and places it in his or her Tavern
Take 2 pu from the supply and place it in your Tavern.  Choose 1 opponent.  That opponent takes 1 pu from the supply and places it in his or her Tavern
Each opponent removes 1 wh from his or her Tavern and returns it to the supply.  For each opponent that could not do so, you score 2 VP
1 wh + 1 oj + 1 pu = 4 VP
2 wh + 1 oj = 4 VP

Discard a Building under you control that currently has no Agent assigned to it.  Then choose 1 Building in Builder's Hall and putit in play under your control at no cost.  (Replace that Building afterward.)
Return 1 of your assigned Agent to your pool
Take 2 bl from the supply and place it in your Tavern.  Each opponent can choose to give you 1 bl once to score 3 VP (Place it in your Tavern.)
1 wh + 2 bl = 2 VP
Take 2 oj from the supply and place it in your Tavern.  Each opponent can choose to give you 1 oj once to score 3 VP (Place it in your Tavern.)
Take 1 pu from the supply and place it in your Tavern.  Each opponent can choose to give you 1 pu once to score 5 VP (Place it in your Tavern.)
Assign 1 of your unused Agent to a Building in Builder's Hall.  You immediately use the effect of that Building as though you controlled it.
Choose a Quest type: Arcana, Commerce, Piety, Skullduggery, or Warfare.  Draw and reveal Quests until you reveal a card of the choosen type.  Keep that Quest and discard the rest.
take 4 gold from the supply and choose 1 opponent.  That opponent takes 2 gold from the supply
1 wh + 1 oj + 1 bl = 2 VP
Take 1 wh from the supply and place it in your Tavern.  Each opponent can choose to give you 1 wh once to score 5 VP (Place it in your Tavern.)
take 4 gold from the supply.  Each opponent can choose to pay you 4 gold to score 4 VP
